chunks: Ibn Abī Najrān, from Muthannā, from Zurārah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

I said to him: A man dug a well in other than his own property, then a man passed by it and fell into it. So he said: “Liability is upon him, because everyone who digs in other than his own property, liability is upon him.”

key_terms.فِي غَيْرِ مِلْكِهِ: on property not owned by him
key_terms.ٱلضَّمَانُ: legal liability or responsibility for the resulting harm

ai.seo_question: Is a person liable if someone falls into a well he dug on land that does not belong to him?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that a person who digs a well on property that is not his own bears liability if someone falls into it. Its significance is in establishing responsibility for harm caused by unauthorized hazardous acts affecting the rights and safety of others.
